summary.explanation: Excessively bright scenes pose a significant risk to AR systems due to potential damage from excessive light. Adjustments include using filters or adjusting exposure settings to ensure better quality in these areas.

Increase ambient lighting or use supplemental light sources
Position light sources to evenly illuminate the scene
